jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionPlain:
Linear is looking for a senior product designer to craft the future of our China-facing surfaces. You will own discovery through delivery for a core product area, partnering closely with engineering.

You will also help evolve our design system and raise the craft bar across the team.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionPlain: Own Linear's brand visual language across product marketing surfaces.
